passages.note: Nguyen is listed as a co-sponsor of SB1165, a single-subject girls'-teams-by-biological-sex bill.
Nguyen voted Yea on House Third Reading of SB1165, which passed 31-24-5-0-0, well above the near-unanimous threshold.

passages.provision_quote: Athletic teams or sports designated for "females", "women" or "girls" may not be open to students of the male sex.
passages.note: This section does not restrict the eligibility of any student to participate in any team designated for males or as coed, which excludes rung 5.

rows.reasoning: Nguyen co-sponsored SB1165 and voted Yea (NGUYEN Y) on its House Third Reading; the enacted law requires that teams designated for females, women or girls not be open to students of the male sex while teams designated for males or as coed remain open to all, matching the rung text 'require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth' and excluding the rung 5 total ban because boys'/coed teams stay open.
